description: Chart.js draws charts on a canvas. You supply labels, values and a few options. Learn how to choose a clear chart, label its numbers and update it without hiding the data from readers. Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.
versionNote: Uses Chart.js 4 and the chart.js/auto registration entry point.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to choose a clear label for minutes spent reading
Learn to add a point for 20 pages and 35 minutes
Learn to change the holder width and watch the chart resize
learningObjectives: Learn to choose a clear label for minutes spent reading
Learn to add a point for 20 pages and 35 minutes
Learn to change the holder width and watch the chart resize
